verdictBody: All three indicators stay well below trigger; continued claims touched a fresh 2026 low in mid-October even as September payroll growth slowed sharply to +29K after downward revisions to July and August.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: The insured unemployment rate has held flat at 1.1% since early September, matching this year's low with no drift toward the 20% trigger.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Continued claims dipped to a fresh 2026 low of 1.695M in mid-October before settling at 1.718M, while nonfarm payrolls grew just +29K in September.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Initial claims have held in a calm 194K-200K band since late September, still near 2026 lows even as job growth cooled sharply.

stats.label: Insured Unemployment Rate
stats.note: Unchanged since early Sept.; at 2026 low

stats.label: Initial Claims
stats.note: Near 2026 lows for six straight weeks

stats.label: Continued Claims
stats.note: Touched a new 2026 low of 1.695M in mid-Oct.

stats.label: Nonfarm Payrolls
stats.note: Sharp slowdown; 12-mo avg. +45K/mo after Jul./Aug. revised down a combined 60K
